mission: Mission 3AL - ASL Citizen bounded Brev training

approval.scope: one bounded remote ASL Citizen lesson-milestone training/evaluation pass on the existing Brev worker

compute_receipt.expected_signal: Determine whether the approved tensor-backed 25-label ASL Citizen lesson milestone can fit beyond the local one-epoch smoke and produce held-out evidence.
compute_receipt.kill_condition: Kill if CUDA is unavailable, training falls back to CPU, loss becomes NaN, no epoch/progress output appears for 15 minutes, sync/preflight cannot verify required data, or timeout fires.

training.command: brev exec asl-pilot-rawframe-001 "cd /home/shadeform/asl-pilot && timeout 5400s ./.venv/bin/python scripts/train_rawframe_model.py --train-manifest data/manifests/lesson/rawframe-milestone/train.json --validation-manifest data/manifests/lesson/rawframe-milestone/validation.json --test-manifest data/manifests/lesson/rawframe-milestone/test.json --output-dir artifacts/rawframe-lesson-milestone --model-id asl-pilot-asl-citizen-lesson-brev-full-v1 --architecture motion_2d_temporal_cnn --lesson-milestone --check-files --epochs 40 --batch-size 16 --frame-count 12 --image-size 96 --learning-rate 0.001 --training-augmentation mild --checkpoint-selection best_validation --num-workers 2"

evaluation.command: brev exec asl-pilot-rawframe-001 "cd /home/shadeform/asl-pilot && timeout 1800s ./.venv/bin/python scripts/evaluate_rawframe_model.py --lesson-milestone --checkpoint artifacts/rawframe-lesson-milestone/model_state.pt --training-provenance artifacts/rawframe-lesson-milestone/training-provenance.json --train-manifest data/manifests/lesson/rawframe-milestone/train.json --validation-manifest data/manifests/lesson/rawframe-milestone/validation.json --test-manifest data/manifests/lesson/rawframe-milestone/test.json --challenge-manifest data/manifests/negative-challenge.json --output-report artifacts/rawframe-lesson-milestone/validation-report.json --calibrated-provenance artifacts/rawframe-lesson-milestone/calibrated-provenance.json --prediction-sidecar artifacts/rawframe-lesson-milestone/prediction-sidecar.json --batch-size 16 --num-workers 2"
evaluation.blocker: data/manifests/negative-challenge.json: negative challenge manifest needs at least 5 clips for each required type; missing/underfilled: casual_non_asl_gesture, counting, fingerspelling_like_motion, hand_clap, hands_cropped_out, idle_hands, mouth_touch, partial_sign, thumbs_up, waving, wrong_location, wrong_palm_orientation
